admission.justification: Verified against frozen 242 paseo_authority.py (require_user_settings_path) and the retargeted install/start/runtime plus host-release tests; admitted under Owner semantic case 4ef8129e.

applicability: Host-authority preparation and per-use reads on the current installation, with developer role-settings location handled separately.
conditions: The MCP configPath file owns host authority; an absent file or block selects no host until admitted setup creates it.
An existing host block is preserved rather than rewritten; callers retain modeled unreadable or malformed authority refusals.
XDG_CONFIG_HOME or the standard user config directory selects the separate developer user-settings path.
An old coordinationRoot/system/settings.json user-settings file refuses before its contents are read; the explicit upgrade owns whole-file migration.
exclusions: A user-settings or per-harness host fallback.
Partial user-settings copies; the upgrade moves the whole user file.
Host-authority preparation does not initialize or rewrite developer role settings.
